start.name: {name}
start.text: *April, cherry blossom petals scattering in front of the school gate. I smooth the collar of my new uniform and resettle the strap of the bag holding my transfer papers.*

start_again.name: {name}
start_again.text: *A sudden wave of dizziness hits, and I stop with a hand against the gate pillar. Catching my ragged breath, I wait for my churning stomach to settle.*

start_3.name: {name}
start_3.text: *The phone in my pocket buzzes once. I look down at the familiar names in the old school group chat and quietly turn the screen off.*

gate_1.name: {name}
gate_1.text: *In the shade of the school gate, a girl with long wavy hair pushes up her glasses and checks her wristwatch. At my footsteps, her gaze lifts slowly behind the lenses.*

seoyeon_meet_1.name: Seoyeon
seoyeon_meet_1.text: You the transfer student who came today? {name}, right?

seoyeon_meet_2.name: Seoyeon
seoyeon_meet_2.text: Nice to meet you, {name}. I'm Seoyeon, the student council president. *She leaves a light check mark next to my name on the clipboard roster.*

seoyeon_meet_3.name: {name}
seoyeon_meet_3.text: That's me. We haven't met before—how did you spot me right away?

seoyeon_meet_4.name: Seoyeon
seoyeon_meet_4.text: Who else would be lingering by the gate in a brand-new uniform? Welcoming transfer students is part of my job.

seoyeon_meet_5.name: Seoyeon
seoyeon_meet_5.text: Follow me this way. We have 15 minutes before morning homeroom, so I'll walk you through the school layout first.

seoyeon_meet_6.name: {name}
seoyeon_meet_6.text: A personal tour from the student council president on day one? That's pretty generous treatment.

seoyeon_meet_7.name: Seoyeon
seoyeon_meet_7.text: Don't flatter yourself. If you get lost and show up late to homeroom, it just makes more work for me.

seoyeon_meet_8.name: Seoyeon
seoyeon_meet_8.text: Alright, let's go. *As Seoyeon turns, a faint scent of fabric softener dried in the sun brushes off the collar of her uniform shirt.*

seoyeon_choice.name: {name}
seoyeon_choice.text: *Watching Seoyeon walk a step ahead of me, I speak up.*
choices: Wait — you didn't come all the way out here just for me, did you?
So what's the tour gonna cost me?
It's fine, I'll just figure it out myself.

choice_dismiss_1.name: Seoyeon
choice_dismiss_1.text: It's your first day. You really okay finding it on your own, {name}? *She stops and turns her head halfway to look at me.*

choice_dismiss_2.name: Seoyeon
choice_dismiss_2.text: If that's what you want, I won't drag you along. Class 3-2 is at the far right end of the 3rd-floor hall in the main building—and if you have nowhere to go at lunch, come up to the rooftop.

choice_dismiss_3.name: Seoyeon
choice_dismiss_3.text: *She tucks the clipboard against her chest and climbs the stairs inside the gate with a steady step.*

choice_flirt_1.name: Seoyeon
choice_flirt_1.text: *She stops, turns halfway, and the corners of her eyes curve just a little behind the clear lenses.*

choice_flirt_2.name: Seoyeon
choice_flirt_2.text: Room to joke on your first day as a transfer. I'll have your name memorized in one go.

choice_flirt_3.name: {name}
choice_flirt_3.text: Oh, are you scoring first impressions or something?

choice_flirt_4.name: Seoyeon
choice_flirt_4.text: Well. You don't seem to know the school yet, but that first impression is worth a pretty generous score.

choice_flirt_5.name: {name}
choice_flirt_5.text: A generous score from the student council president? I'm honored.

choice_flirt_6.name: Seoyeon
choice_flirt_6.text: We'll see if you can still smile that easily a week from now.

choice_flirt_7.name: Seoyeon
choice_flirt_7.text: We'll be late. Follow me, {name}. *She covers a slightly flushed ear with her hair and walks a step ahead.*

choice_joke_1.name: Seoyeon
choice_joke_1.text: Today's tour is free, just this once. I'll collect it with interest later, when the student council is short on hands.

choice_joke_2.name: {name}
choice_joke_2.text: They say nothing's free. Scary student council president.

choice_joke_3.name: Seoyeon
choice_joke_3.text: Stick with me and school at least won't be boring.

hallway_1.name: Seoyeon
hallway_1.text: No need to slow down while people greet me. Just match my stride. *She answers the greetings pouring in down the hall with a light raise of her hand.*

hallway_3.name: Seoyeon
hallway_3.text: The main building we're walking through is the third-year building, and the library is across the windows. Go down the basement stairs and the snack bar is right there.

hallway_4.name: Seoyeon
hallway_4.text: And this isn't something I show just anyone. *She takes a silver key from her jacket pocket and jingles it on her fingertips.*

hallway_5.name: Seoyeon
hallway_5.text: Our school rooftop is usually kept locked. Only the student council president holds this key.

hallway_6.name: {name}
hallway_6.text: You hiding a secret hideout of your own up on the roof?

hallway_6_b.name: Seoyeon
hallway_6_b.text: *The clear jingle of the key ring stops short in her hand.* Quicker on the uptake than I thought.

hallway_6_c.name: Seoyeon
hallway_6_c.text: *The corner of her mouth lifts a little, and instead of answering she slips the key deep into her pocket.*

hallway_7.name: Seoyeon
hallway_7.text: Oh, right—if you don't have anywhere in particular to go at lunch today, want to come up to the rooftop I mentioned?

hallway_8.name: {name}
hallway_8.text: *Stopping in front of the door, Seoyeon averts her gaze slightly and points at the sunlit classroom plaque.*

hallway_10.name: Seoyeon
hallway_10.text: Here we are—this is your classroom. Head on in before homeroom starts.

hallway_11.name: {name}
hallway_11.text: Up on the rooftop—does that mean I get one-on-one attention at lunch too?

hallway_12.name: Seoyeon
hallway_12.text: We'll see. Depends on you getting through this morning's classes.

hallway_13.name: Seoyeon
hallway_13.text: *Half-turned, Seoyeon raises her clipboard lightly to shoulder height in farewell before turning away down the hall.*

hallway_13_b.name: {name}
hallway_13_b.text: *I watch Seoyeon's retreating figure for a moment as her steady footsteps fade down the hall.*

classroom_1.name: {name}
classroom_1.text: *Rattle—as I slide the front door open, the noisy classroom falls quiet and every gaze inside turns toward me.* Hello.

classroom_2_b.name: {name}
classroom_2_b.text: *At the lectern stands our homeroom teacher, looking to be in her late 20s. Wearing a beige cardigan with the attendance book in hand, she gives me a brief nod.*

classroom_3.name: Homeroom Teacher
classroom_3.text: Settle down, everyone. This is the transfer student joining our class today. Step up front and keep your intro brief.

classroom_3_b.name: {name}
classroom_3_b.text: I'm {name}, transferring in today. Nice to meet you all. *Once I finish, the homeroom teacher nods once and makes a quick mark beside my name in the attendance book.*

classroom_5_b.name: Homeroom Teacher
classroom_5_b.text: That'll do, {name}. Ask your desk neighbor if you're unsure about anything, and take your time getting used to things.

classroom_5_c.name: {name}
classroom_5_c.text: *As I look up from the front of the room, a playful whistle rings out brightly from a back corner.*

classroom_dain_1.name: Dain
classroom_dain_1.text: Oh, a transfer student! Finally, a new face in our class!

classroom_dain_2.name: Dain
classroom_dain_2.text: Over here, over here! *A girl with short brown hair and a volleyball uniform gets up from her seat and gives a lively wave.*

classroom_dain_3.name: Homeroom Teacher
classroom_dain_3.text: Dain, keep your voice down. It's morning. And I told you to take that gym uniform off in the classroom.

classroom_dain_4.name: Dain
classroom_dain_4.text: Aw, come on, teach. This is the most comfortable thing in the world! Anyway, transfer student, so glad you're here!

classroom_dain_5.name: Dain
classroom_dain_5.text: The seat next to me is open—over here! *Through the classmates' laughter, she stretches a lively arm even higher and waves me over.*

classroom_dain_5_b.name: Homeroom Teacher
classroom_dain_5_b.text: Dain, at least settle down while I call attendance. *With the hand holding the chalk, she taps the podium lightly, twice.*

classroom_dain_5_c.name: Homeroom Teacher
classroom_dain_5_c.text: What if you burn all that energy now? The period 1 bell hasn't even rung.

classroom_dain_5_d.name: Homeroom Teacher
classroom_dain_5_d.text: *Letting out a brief sigh, the homeroom teacher knits her brows slightly and taps the lectern with the attendance book.*

classroom_yuna_1.name: {name}
classroom_yuna_1.text: *Apart from the noisy classroom, in the last seat by the window, only the girl with silver-white hair quietly turns a page.*

classroom_yuna_4.name: {name}
classroom_yuna_4.text: *A student in the front row brushes my sleeve and whispers, "Don't talk to her. The rumors are kind of scary." Even amid the chatter, the girl by the window turns the next page at an unhurried pace.*

classroom_seat_1.name: Homeroom Teacher
classroom_seat_1.text: *Closing the attendance book, the homeroom teacher points toward an empty desk near the back of the window row.*

classroom_seat_2.name: Dain
classroom_seat_2.text: Nice, you really are right next to me! Don't just stand there—come sit! *She pulls her chair in and turns her upper body toward me.*

classroom_minsu_1.name: {name}
classroom_minsu_1.text: *I set my bag down and start to pull the chair out when the boy in front grabs the backrest and whips around.*

classroom_minsu_2.name: Minsu
classroom_minsu_2.text: Hey, transfer. Out of all seats, you landed right there. Better brace yourself starting today.

classroom_minsu_2_b.name: Minsu
classroom_minsu_2_b.text: *He flicks his chin toward Dain beside me and grins.* If you want to keep up with that energy, you'd better start saving your stamina now.

classroom_dain_talk_1.name: {name}
classroom_dain_talk_1.text: *On the uniform name tag of the boy turning around in the front seat with a grin, I catch the name "Minsu."*

classroom_dain_talk_2.name: Dain
classroom_dain_talk_2.text: Don't mind what that guy said! Anyway, can I ask you something? *She leans in so far her upper body crosses the edge of my desk.*

classroom_dain_talk_3.name: Dain
classroom_dain_talk_3.text: Hey, {name}. You like moving around, or sports?

classroom_dain_talk_4.name: {name}
classroom_dain_talk_4.text: Sports? Why, all of a sudden?

classroom_dain_talk_5.name: Dain
classroom_dain_talk_5.text: Well, lately I've been wanting extra receive practice after school, and it's tough finding someone to toss me balls.

classroom_dain_talk_6.name: {name}
classroom_dain_talk_6.text: Using the transfer student as a human ball machine from day one?

classroom_dain_talk_7.name: Dain
classroom_dain_talk_7.text: Come on, as if! Syncing up with a real person is way more fun than practicing with a machine!

classroom_dain_talk_8.name: Dain
classroom_dain_talk_8.text: So, want to try it together? *Dain's index finger sketches a tiny volleyball court and a net line across the wood grain of my desk.*

classroom_yuna_note_1.name: {name}
classroom_yuna_note_1.text: *A folded note slides from the seat behind me onto the corner of my desk. I turn around, but the silver-haired girl just stares out the window as if she knows nothing about it.*

classroom_yuna_note_3.name: Yuna
classroom_yuna_note_3.text: *I unfold the creased corner, and neat lavender handwriting catches my eye.* Noisy seat from day one. — Yuna

classroom_yuna_note_5.name: {name}
classroom_yuna_note_5.text: *When I glance back again, Yuna's pale fingertips—caught in the window sunlight—slip quietly down beneath her desk.*

classroom_yuna_note_6.name: {name}
classroom_yuna_note_6.text: *The period 1 bell fills the classroom. Between the quiet gaze behind me and Dain's lively warmth beside me, my first day begins.*
